identity.name: The Baltic Prism
identity.description: A design system that mirrors the Latvian landscape—shifting from deep pine forests to golden amber shores. It avoids the 'corporate tourism' look by using editorial typography and immersive full-width photography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Unbounded' or 'Syne' font from Google Fonts for all headings to give a unique character.
Implement the 'Amber Glow' color for interactive states (hover, focus).
Ensure the 'Latvian Carmine' red is used ONLY for primary actions to maintain the 'calm nature' vibe.
The map component is critical. Use 'react-leaflet'. Style the map tiles to be clean (e.g., CartoDB Positron) if possible, or standard OSM.
For the 'Road History' page, use a vertical timeline layout connecting events with a dashed 'road line'.
All images must use the 'object-cover' class to ensure they fill their containers beautifully.
Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions—slide in from right to left like moving forward on a road.
Create a 'LanguageSwitcher' component that is prominent in the header (RU/LV/EN).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic gradients. Use the defined 'Forest Deep' and 'Amber Glow'.
Avoid 'Inter' for Headings. Use the Display font defined.
Every interactive element must have a hover state that lifts it or changes color.
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards, especially white text on images (use overlays).
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
